summary: Run the CI deployment planning preset
description: Builds a validation-safe deployment plan, writes JSON and HTML report artifacts, emits GitHub Actions output keys, and returns deterministic CI exit codes.
flags.source-path.description: Path to the Salesforce source directory used to build the deployment plan.
flags.report-dir.summary: Directory where JSON and HTML deployment plan reports are written
flags.report-dir.description: Defaults to the deployment plan report service location under the analyzed project.
flags.validation-mode.summary: CI exit-code policy for deployment planning blockers
flags.validation-mode.description: strict exits non-zero for blockers, warn-only reports blockers with exit code 0, and local-only avoids org-dependent validation expectations.
flags.skip-tests.summary: Record that Apex tests should be skipped by downstream validation
flags.use-ai.summary: Use configured AI providers for dependency inference and wave priority analysis
flags.org-type.summary: Target org type used by AI wave priority analysis
flags.industry.summary: Industry context used by AI wave priority analysis
flags.scope-commits.summary: Comma-separated commit SHAs or refs to include in the CI deployment scope
flags.scope-commits.description: Limits CI plan artifacts to metadata changed by these commits plus required dependencies.
flags.scope-manifest.summary: Path to a JSON commit or story scope manifest
flags.scope-manifest.description: Reads commits from { commits: [] } and { stories: [{ commits: [] }] } for trunk-based validation.
